Use Run Workflow with the workflowPrompt form (automatic creation, not a recipe) for the task below.
Launch it and end your turn right away; do not wait for the workflow, do not inspect it, and do not do any of the work yourself.

Task brief for the workflow:
Work only inside /work/plan-write-declined. No shell commands, no git, no worktree, no tests.
Build one repeat loop with maxIterations 3 and onMaxIterations "pause", stopping when /work/plan-write-declined/review.json has verdict "APPROVED" (fileCheck).
Inside the loop: step "draft" (agent wf-coder) writes /work/plan-write-declined/note.md, a three-line poem about tunnels; if /work/plan-write-declined/review.json exists it first reads it and fixes every finding.
Then step "review" (agent wf-coder): if /work/plan-write-declined/round.txt does not exist, create it containing 1 and write /work/plan-write-declined/review.json as {"verdict":"CHANGES_REQUESTED","findings":["Add a title line above the poem"],"reviewDoc":"/work/plan-write-declined/review.json"}; if round.txt exists, write review.json with verdict "APPROVED" and no findings. It conveys the verdict only through that file and always calls send_message with severity success.
After the loop, step "summarize" (agent wf-planner) reads /work/plan-write-declined/note.md and replies with the final poem.
